title: Recovery of active sign coordinates
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, let $y$ be a sign vector of length $2m^2$, and let $i$ be an index in that vector. In a sign cube of dimension $2^m$, take the active coordinates to be those with index less than $2m^2$, place the entries of $y$ on those coordinates in their natural order, and assign $+1$ to every other coordinate. The resulting vector has value $y(i)$ at the coordinate indexed by $i$.
hypotheses_covered: m is a natural number with 7 ≤ m
y is a sign vector of length 2m²
i is an index in a vector of length 2m²
